Q1: Toxaphene exhibits significant, internationally recognized hazards (Tier 1) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, acute and chronic environmental hazards, inhalation, oral, dermal/eye, and organ/systemic hazards. Q2: Toxaphene is identified on numerous prominent lists of concern, highlighting its significant hazards. It is not listed on any low hazard lists.
Q3: Despite a substantial body of scientific literature with 4855 references, significantly higher than the median for this chemical set, Toxaphene's chemical characterization is incomplete.
